overloads.semanticRole: Removes the attribute named attribName from the XML element elementRef, if it exists.

constraints: Sets the OK system variable to 1 on success, or 0 (with an error) if attribName does not exist on elementRef.
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close
